title: Yellowed Velvety Mediterranean Sweet Potatoes Tagine
description: A charred and velvety Mediterranean dish featuring sweet potatoes, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, perfect for a paleo-friendly dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large ttukbaegi earthenware pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cubed sweet potatoes, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 45 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
